up: For the assay with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL1614161, return the exact activity values (including the relation, value, and units) and the canonical SMILES for the tested compounds. Include all activity records associated with this assay.
sql:
SELECT
  activities.standard_relation,
  activities.standard_value,
  activities.standard_units,
  compound_structures.canonical_smiles
FROM activities
JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614161';
